name: 6-bromotryptamine
summary: 6-Bromotryptamine is a substituted tryptamine that is a marine natural product.

uses.en: It is studied as a marine natural product. It has no medical or recreational use.
uses.zh: 它作為海洋天然產物被研究，沒有醫療或娛樂用途。
uses.zhHans: 它作为海洋天然产物被研究，没有医疗或娱乐用途。

fact.en: It is a natural product from the sea. Marine organisms such as sponges and molluscs make many brominated compounds, drawing the bromine straight from seawater.
fact.zh: 它是來自海洋的天然產物。海綿與軟體動物等海洋生物會製造許多含溴化合物，而溴就直接取自海水。
fact.zhHans: 它是来自海洋的天然产物。海绵与软件动物等海洋生物会制造许多含溴化合物，而溴就直接取自海水。
